title: Baker Mayfield: Buccaneers will "shock a lot of people" this year

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Baker Mayfield: Buccaneers will "shock a lot of people" this year
sources.description: It gets a little exhausting when an NFL franchise finds motivation from the fact that: (1) the team hasn't performed up to snuff; and (2) others have noticed.
